about: Fire pump set modelled as a generic product: base frame; electric pump with finned motor, fan cowl, terminal box, coupling guard and volute; diesel pump with engine block, head, rocker cover, radiator and grille, air filter, exhaust and silencer, batteries, day tank on legs; vertical multistage jockey pump; suction and discharge headers with check valves, valves and handwheels; three controllers with displays and lamps.
